{{Top|leg}}
The '''plasma pulse discharger''' was a weapon used by the [[Dreadnought battle tank]] during the [[Battle of Thule]]. The weapon was fired by charging up and then discharging a powerful shock wave that radiated outward from the dreadnought tank, disrupting enemy vehicles in the tank's immediate vicinity for a brief amount of time.

{{Weapon-stub}}

This weapon appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']].
